title: XGBoost model predicts miscarriage in women with PCOS after fresh embryo transfer
summary: A multicenter study of 8,911 clinical-pregnancy IVF/ICSI cycles in women with PCOS covered development (n=7,241; 973 miscarriages), external validation (n=1,170; 146) and prospective temporal validation (n=500; 62) cohorts. Thirteen candidate algorithms were compared by repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation and a prelocked XGBoost model was carried unchanged into external and temporal validation. Miscarriage rates were 13.4%, 12.5% and 12.4%; AUC values were not visible in the reviewed abstract, and the model applies only to fresh transfers in PCOS.
ai_technology: Pre-locked XGBoost classifier selected from 13 candidate algorithms

evidence.tested: Geographic external validation (n=1,170) and temporal validation (n=500) with the model locked.
evidence.unknown: Performance values beyond those in the reviewed abstract excerpt, and whether the temporal cohort preceded outcomes in the intended workflow; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts miscarriage risk after confirmed clinical pregnancy
